categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies addrman address selection logic in src/addrman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes severe statistical bias in addrman bucket sampling where sparse entries could be selected with drastically skewed probabilities (e.g. 95.3% vs 4.7%). Uniform address sampling strengthens peer selection and eclipse resistance across the network.
